about: The 2002 third-person survival horror shooter that serves as a sequel to the genre-defining 1982 film is back, remastered by Nightdive Studios to bring this innovative blend of fast paced squad action meets survival horror to the modern era.
Including Antialiasing, Per Pixel Lighting, 4K Resolution and up to 120 FPS.
Where the movie ended, the true terror begins.
You are Cpt J.F. Blake, leader of a U.S.

Special Forces rescue team sent to investigate the blood-curdling events and enigmatic deaths of the American scientific team that transpired at the  Outpost 31 research facility located in the frozen wastelands of Antarctica.
Within these inhospitable surroundings your team encounters a strange shape-shifting alien life-form that assumes the appearance of people that it kills.
